pool_rule: Domain filter first: a work must mention a finance/economics/market term in its title, abstract or venue (cross-field family K: or a fusion/reliability/uncertainty term). Then a work enters the screening pool if it is retrieved by >=3 distinct queries, OR ranks in the top 5 of any query in any source, OR has >=300 citations, OR is a seed/known-anchor record, OR is a 2023-2026 record in the top 10 of any query (recent work has had no time to accumulate citations). Works with no title, published before 1985, or of a type that is not a paper/preprint/report/chapter are excluded with a counted reason. The pool is a screening pool, not the review: forward/backward citation tracing and domain-restricted gap-filling searches add records afterwards and are logged separately.
